title: Publish and share artifacts in ParchMark
summary: Lets a user publish self-contained HTML, Markdown or SVG artifacts to a stable versioned URL, view them in the web app, and share an unlisted link, with the ParchMark MCP server publishing on the user's behalf.
motivation: Coding harnesses produce shareable output that today has nowhere to live.

included: per-user API tokens (create, list, revoke) and token auth in the backend and the MCP client
artifacts and artifact_versions tables, migration, service and ownership rules
REST endpoints to publish, update, list, get and delete artifacts and to set visibility
serving artifact content from a separate origin in a sandboxed iframe under a strict Content Security Policy
an Artifacts mode in the web app (gallery plus viewer) and token management in Settings
MCP tools publish_artifact, update_artifact, list_artifacts, get_artifact, set_artifact_visibility
excluded: binary artifact types (images, PDF) and object storage
JSX/React compilation and zipped static sites
scoped tokens (one full-account scope in v1)
org-wide read access and password-protected links
auto-publishing heuristics (the calling agent decides when to publish)

design_facts.stack: Python/FastAPI backend + Vue 3 UI + Python FastMCP MCP server, PostgreSQL

work_items.title: Issue and revoke per-user API tokens
work_items.summary: Adds a personal access token model and endpoints so a non-browser client can authenticate without the user's password.
work_items.contract: POST /api/auth/tokens creates a token and returns the plaintext once; GET /api/auth/tokens lists token metadata; DELETE /api/auth/tokens/{token_id} revokes it. An Authorization: Bearer token authenticates the same as a JWT access token inside the auth dependency.

signals: contract mutation: new authentication surface and new database table

oracle.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest tests/ -q
assertions: a created token authenticates a request
a revoked token is rejected with 401
the plaintext is returned only at creation

work_items.title: Manage tokens in Settings
work_items.summary: Adds a Settings section to name, create, copy once and revoke API tokens.
work_items.contract: The Settings view lists the signed-in user's tokens and creates and revokes them through the token endpoints; the plaintext is shown once after creation and never again.

oracle.command: npm run lint && npm run test
assertions: create and revoke call the API client

work_items.title: Authenticate the MCP server with a token
work_items.summary: Switches the MCP server from a username and password to a PARCHMARK_TOKEN environment variable.
work_items.contract: The MCP server reads PARCHMARK_URL and PARCHMARK_TOKEN and sends the token as Authorization: Bearer on every request. PARCHMARK_USERNAME and PARCHMARK_PASSWORD are no longer read.

signals: contract mutation: replaces the documented environment variables

oracle.command: uv run pyright src/ tests/ && uv run pytest tests/ -q
assertions: the client sends the token header and never logs in
a missing PARCHMARK_TOKEN raises a tool error

work_items.title: Model artifacts and their versions
work_items.summary: Adds artifacts and artifact_versions tables, a migration, and the service and ownership rules behind them.
work_items.contract: An artifact has an id, owner_id, stable unguessable slug, title, a visibility value of private or unlisted, and a current_version_id. A version has an id, artifact_id, monotonically increasing version number, content_type in html, markdown or svg, raw content, and a created_at. Every read is filtered by owner_id.

oracle.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest tests/ -q
assertions: publishing a version increments the version number and moves current_version_id
another user's artifact is not readable

work_items.title: Publish artifacts over the API
work_items.summary: Adds REST endpoints to publish an artifact, publish a new version, list, get, delete and set visibility.
work_items.contract: POST /api/artifacts publishes a new artifact and its first version; POST /api/artifacts/{artifact_id}/versions adds an immutable version; GET /api/artifacts lists the caller's artifacts; GET /api/artifacts/{artifact_id} returns metadata and the current version; POST /api/artifacts/{artifact_id}/visibility sets private or unlisted; DELETE /api/artifacts/{artifact_id} removes the artifact and its versions. The public content path is served under /a/<slug>.

signals: contract mutation: new public API surface

oracle.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest tests/ -q
assertions: publish, new version, list, get, set visibility and delete all behave as declared
an unlisted artifact is readable at its slug by an unauthenticated request and a private one is not

work_items.title: Serve artifact content from a separate origin
work_items.summary: Serves raw artifact content from an origin separate from the app, in a sandboxed iframe under a strict Content Security Policy.
work_items.contract: A content route serves the raw bytes of the version named at /a/<slug> with a restrictive Content-Security-Policy and no app cookies. The web viewer embeds it in an iframe with the sandbox attribute and no allow-same-origin. Markdown artifacts render through the existing sanitized render path instead of raw iframe content.

signals: capability escalation: new serving origin and sandbox policy

oracle.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest tests/ -q
assertions: the content route sets the strict Content-Security-Policy header
the content route sends no authentication cookies
an svg artifact is served with a restrictive content type

work_items.title: Add the Artifacts view to the web app
work_items.summary: Adds an Artifacts mode with a gallery list and a full-screen viewer with share controls.
work_items.contract: A new Artifacts mode in AppShell.vue shows the signed-in user's artifacts as a gallery and opens one in a full-screen viewer that embeds the content origin and offers copy-link and set-visibility controls. The share link is /a/<slug>.

oracle.command: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage
assertions: the gallery lists artifacts from the API
the viewer embeds the content origin in a sandboxed iframe

work_items.title: Publish artifacts from the MCP server
work_items.summary: Adds MCP tools to publish, update, list, get and set visibility of artifacts.
work_items.contract: The MCP server exposes publish_artifact, update_artifact, list_artifacts, get_artifact and set_artifact_visibility, each calling the artifact endpoints and returning the artifact id, title, version number and the /a/<slug> URL.

oracle.command: uv run pyright src/ tests/ && uv run pytest tests/ -q
assertions: set_artifact_visibility accepts private and unlisted only
